## Changes

- Sync bookmarks and reading history across devices with Google Drive. Open **Lainnya → Sinkron** and sign in with Google. The data is kept in the app's hidden Drive folder, so the app cannot see your other Drive files. Sync runs when the app opens, when you come back to it and a few seconds after each change; tap **Sinkronkan sekarang** to sync right away.
- Removing a bookmark or a read chapter on one device also removes it on the others.
- Bookmarks you have not started reading now show the number of chapters on the cover and appear under **Ada Update**.
- New icon for the Lainnya tab.
